stdout:
usage: backlog.py add [-h] [--dir DIR]
                      [--type {bug,feature,improvement,adjustment,epic}]
                      [--title TITLE] [--description DESCRIPTION]
                      [--severity {critical,high,medium,low}]
                      [--priority {high,medium,low}] [--epic EPIC]
                      [--found-in FOUND_IN] [--from-failed] [--run RUN]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dir DIR             Project directory (default: current; the Git root is
                        used)
  --type {bug,feature,improvement,adjustment,epic}
  --title TITLE
  --description DESCRIPTION
  --severity {critical,high,medium,low}
                        Required for bugs
  --priority {high,medium,low}
                        Other types (default: medium)
  --epic EPIC           Epic the item belongs to (EPIC-NNN)
  --found-in FOUND_IN   Where it was found: version, pull request, test
  --from-failed         Capture the manual tests marked Fail in --run as bugs
  --run RUN             Release candidate run, with --from-failed
